mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_pw, u.user_nm, u.dept_code, u.use_yn, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS dept_name FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_dept d ON u.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT r.role_cd, r.role_nm FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_role r ON ur.role_cd = r.role_cd AND r.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ra.srch_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS srch_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.new_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS new_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.save_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS save_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.del_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS del_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.prnt_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS prnt_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.upld_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS upld_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.init_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS init_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.etc1_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS etc1_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.etc2_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS etc2_yn, MAX(CASE WHEN ra.etc3_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS etc3_yn FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_role_auth ra ON ur.role_cd = ra.role_cd AND ra.pgm_id = #{pgmId} WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT da.auth_type, da.auth_target, da.table_name FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_data_auth da ON ur.role_cd = da.role_cd WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE da.auth_type WHEN 'ALL' THEN 1 WHEN 'DEPT_SUB' THEN 2 WHEN 'DEPT' THEN 3 WHEN 'USER' THEN 4 END

WITH RECURSIVE authorized_menus AS ( /* 사용자가 권한을 가진 리프 메뉴 */ SELECT m.menu_id, COALESCE(pi.pgm_nm, m.menu_nm) AS menu_nm, m.parent_id, m.menu_type, m.pgm_id, m.url, COALESCE(pi.icon, '') AS icon, m.sort_order FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_pgm_info pi ON m.pgm_id = pi.pgm_id JOIN tb_role_auth ra ON m.pgm_id = ra.pgm_id JOIN tb_user_role ur ON ra.role_cd = ur.role_cd AND ur.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.menu_type != 'G' AND COALESCE(pi.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' UNION /* 권한 있는 하위 메뉴의 상위 그룹을 재귀적으로 포함 */ SELECT p.menu_id, COALESCE(pi2.pgm_nm, p.menu_nm) AS menu_nm, p.parent_id, p.menu_type, p.pgm_id, p.url, COALESCE(pi2.icon, '') AS icon, p.sort_order FROM tb_menu p LEFT JOIN tb_pgm_info pi2 ON p.pgm_id = pi2.pgm_id JOIN authorized_menus c ON p.menu_id = c.parent_id WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT menu_id, menu_nm, parent_id, menu_type, pgm_id, url, icon, sort_order FROM authorized_menus ORDER BY sort_order
